observations: Photos 0 and 1: the same single blue plastic drum standing on a dirt floor, with other blue drums and a blue jerrycan behind it.
The drum looks like a standard large closed-top plastic drum, roughly the 200 to 220 litre size, but no size or capacity marking is readable.
The top has been cut across and refitted as a hinged lid with three rusty metal hinges; the two original screw bungs with white caps remain on the top.
The body is scuffed and dirty with green paint or stain marks and an embossed 'this way up' arrows mark; no cracks or holes are visible on the shown side.
No photo shows the inside, the base, or the back of the drum.
Both photos carry a Jiji dealer watermark (Saivet Nigeria Enterprise).

identity.kind: used blue plastic drum, about 200 litre, with cut hinged lid

claims.evidence: A general sales statement; photos 0 and 1 show a worn, scuffed drum with rusty hinges on a cut lid.

risks.risk: Previous contents may have been a chemical that leaves the drum unsafe for water or food storage.
risks.proof: A photo inside the open drum in good light, plus a close photo of any original label on the body.
risks.if_unproven: As a drum fit only for non-food, non-water use.

risks.risk: Crack or leak in the base or the unseen side.
risks.proof: A clip of the drum filled with water standing for a few minutes, turned to show all sides and the base.

risks.risk: Actual capacity smaller than a full size drum.
risks.proof: A photo of a tape measure along the drum's height and across its top, or of the moulded capacity marking.
risks.if_unproven: As the smaller common drum size.

risks.risk: Lid hinges rusted or the cut lid not sealing.
risks.proof: A clip opening and closing the lid.

proof_requests: A photo inside the open drum and of any label showing what it held.
A clip of the drum filled with water and turned to show all sides and the base.
A photo with a tape measure along the height and across the top.
A clip opening and closing the hinged lid.
response.reason: It is plainly a used large blue plastic drum with a cut hinged lid, so it is priced by type at its worst case, for non-food use and possibly leaking, until the inside, base and size are shown.
